goal: Bring up a guarded paging Stage 1 path without breaking the default stable boot contract.
subtasks: Document page-table layout, CR0/CR3 assumptions, and ring3 return constraints.
Introduce a gated paging smoke path with explicit debug markers and panic-safe fallback.
Add a paging-enabled QEMU smoke test that remains outside the default stable path.
acceptance: Guarded paging path reaches post-enable debug marker.
Result is reflected in knowledge/discovered_issues.json and validation patterns.

goal: Harden the syscall interface so paging-era user pointer validation can be introduced safely.
subtasks: Define a user-buffer validation API that can run as a permissive stub before paging is enabled.
Apply the validation path to filesystem-related syscalls first.
Add regression notes or tests for illegal syscall numbers and invalid parameters.
acceptance: Filesystem-facing syscalls use a common validation entrypoint.
The ABI notes stay aligned with kernel behavior.

goal: Expand ToyOS regression coverage beyond boot-only smoke checks.
subtasks: Promote user-probe markers into explicit assertions.
Add manual-to-automated shell and filesystem coverage where feasible.
Track experimental regressions separately from stable-path regressions.
acceptance: Automated tests verify more than ordered boot markers.
Stable and experimental regressions are separated.
Regression expectations are documented in a way the self-improvement loop can consume.
